notes: Labels and phases from the table of contents of Gartner document 399359 'Hype Cycle for Emerging Technologies, 2003' (2 July 2003, 15 pages), as shown on the Internet Archive snapshot of 21 Aug 2016. The contents groups each technology profile under a phase heading: On the Rise (mapped to innovation_trigger), At the Peak, Sliding Into the Trough, Climbing the Slope, Entering the Plateau. 31 entries. rank is the order in the table of contents (1 to 31), which is likely the order along the curve but is not confirmed. Bands read from a copy of the chart ('As of July 2003') titled 'Gartner Hype Cycle for Emerging Technologies, 2003' on Pinterest (613x451 GIF). The chart has the same 31 labels as the table of contents. Legend: white <2 years, light blue 2-5, dark blue 5-10, orange triangle >10, red crossed circle obsolete before plateau. Mullany's spreadsheet counts 27 entries for 2003; the table of contents has 31. Labels are verbatim.
